versions.subject: Sigma rules for network service scanning.
versions.detection:
selection_1:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '/dev/tcp/'
selection_2:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/cat'
selection_3:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/nmap'
selection_4:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/telnet'
selection_5:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/nc'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: CommandLine="*/dev/tcp/*" OR ProcessName="*/cat" OR ProcessName="*/nmap" OR ProcessName="*/telnet" OR ProcessName="*/nc"

versions.subject: make it global rule
versions.detection:
selection:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/nmap'
    - '/telnet'
    - '/nc'
    - '/netcat'
condition: selection
selection:
  type: 'SYSCALL'
  exe|endswith:
    - '/nc'
    - '/netcat'
    - '/telnet'
    - '/nmap'
  key: 'network_connect_4'
  condition: selection
versions.spl: type="SYSCALL" exe IN ("*/nc", "*/netcat", "*/telnet", "*/nmap") key="network_connect_4" condition="selection"

versions.subject: Filter out listening mode on nc
versions.detection:
selection:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/nc'
    - '/netcat'
filter:
  CommandLine|contains: 'l'
condition: selection and not filter
selection:
  type: 'SYSCALL'
  exe|endswith:
    - '/telnet'
    - '/nmap'
  key: 'network_connect_4'
  condition: selection
versions.spl: type="SYSCALL" exe IN ("*/telnet", "*/nmap") key="network_connect_4" condition="selection" NOT CommandLine="*l*"

versions.subject: Update lnx_network_service_scanning.yml
versions.detection:

    - '/nc'
    - '/netcat'
network_scanning_tools:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '/telnet' # could be wget, curl, ssh, many things. basically everything that is able to do network connection. consider fine tuning
    - '/nmap'
netcat_listen_flag:
  CommandLine|contains: 'l'
condition: (netcat and not netcat_listen_flag) or network_scanning_tools
selection:
  type: 'SYSCALL'
  exe|endswith:
    - '/telnet'
    - '/nmap'
    - '/netcat'
    - '/nc'
  key: 'network_connect_4'
  condition: selection
versions.spl: (ProcessName IN ("*/nc", "*/netcat") NOT CommandLine="*l*") OR ProcessName IN ("*/telnet", "*/nmap")

versions.subject: Merge PR #4508 from @gs3cl - Update Hacktool and Network Scanner Linux Rules
versions.detection:
selection_netcat:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/nc'
        - '/ncat'
        - '/netcat'
        - '/socat'
selection_network_scanning_tools:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/autorecon'
        - '/hping'
        - '/hping2'
        - '/hping3'
        - '/naabu'
        - '/nmap'
        - '/nping'
        - '/telnet' # could be wget, curl, ssh, many things. basically everything that is able to do network connection. consider fine tuning
filter_main_netcat_listen_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --listen '
        - ' -l '
condition: (selection_netcat and not filter_main_netcat_listen_flag) or selection_network_scanning_tools
versions.spl: (Image IN ("*/nc", "*/ncat", "*/netcat", "*/socat") NOT (CommandLine IN ("* --listen *", "* -l *"))) OR Image IN ("*/autorecon", "*/hping", "*/hping2", "*/hping3", "*/naabu", "*/nmap", "*/nping", "*/telnet")
